Subject: Quickstart CTA — Requesting technical demo for CodePath AI

Hi Mina,

I hit the quickstart CTA on your docs yesterday and spun up a trial environment — appreciate the great docs. We're CodePath AI, a small dev team building a code-assist product, and we want to evaluate Redwood for low-latency inference on moderately long contexts (up to 4k).

Would love a technical demo focused on:
- model variants and quantization options for cost/latency tradeoffs
- VPC/private deployment paths and data retention controls
- example prompt engineering for code generation latency

I'm Pacific time (PDT) and prefer afternoons next week (Mon–Thu after 1pm). Can an engineer join?

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Co-Founder, CodePath AI
alex@codepath.ai

- Tue Jul 16, 14:00–14:45
- Wed Jul 17, 15:00–15:45
- Thu Jul 18, 13:30–14:15

If none of those work, tell me 2–3 windows that do and I'll loop in an engineer. I attached a short tech intake form to capture model/scale details (small PDF). Also here is a one-click calendar link if you'd rather pick directly: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=codepath-demo-58213

Quick note: to make the demo most useful, can you paste an example prompt or short sample input you care about?

Also, we have two quick technical asks so you can route the right engineer:
1) We want to run a quantized LLM for code completion (4k context) behind a VPC — is private deployment supported for the 4k variants?
2) Can you show how Redwood manages KV cache across concurrent sessions (we have many short-lived dev sessions)?

I can do Thu Jul 18 between 13:30–14:15 PDT if that works for your engineer. If not, Tue Jul 16 after 14:30 is OK. Please include an engineer on the invite.

— Alex
